text: The initial landing packages its manager only for cocoa and registers the native component only for Darwin, but its lazy getter attempts to import the resource inside try/catch before reaching the manager's isAvailable getter. The fixed accepted getter first tests nsIMacQuickLook in Ci, then imports. That source ordering is the supported platform boundary; the later reported broken-resource failure is attributed discussion, not a new build result. No cross-platform support, successful native build or global import rule is inferred.
title: The original Quick Look import precedes its platform availability check
